svg.aria-label: BirmanLayer: what the right Option key types
svg.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Segoe UI', Arial, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif
svg.text: right ⌥ + key types the lower character, ⇧ + right ⌥ the upper one; a boxed accent is a dead key: press it, then a letter.
